instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Say whether a post is ready for each place it is going, and what each place will refuse, before it is approved or set to go", and give it post_id (A post_id from tool:draft-a-post or tool:read-post-calendar).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:check-a-post and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give post_id.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: post (records:read); connection (records:list).
